timeline.title: Info sessions
timeline.detail: Meet officers, learn programming requirements, and ask questions about time commitment. At least one session is required to rush.

timeline.title: Application
timeline.detail: Submit academic info, pathway interest, service background, and short written responses.

timeline.title: Interview
timeline.detail: Structured conversation with membership committee focused on fit, goals, and readiness.

timeline.title: Bid & education
timeline.detail: Accepted candidates receive a bid and complete new-member education before initiation.

whyJoin.title: Professional development & service
whyJoin.body: Speaker series, skills clinics, and Tampa Bay service partners that strengthen both applications and character.

whyJoin.title: Academic support

whyJoin.title: Inclusivity across pathways
whyJoin.body: MD, DO, PA, dental, pharmacy, nursing, and research tracks—same seriousness for every path.

whyJoin.title: Community that lasts
whyJoin.body: A brotherhood at UT that shows up for exams, interviews, and life after Tampa.

faq.q: Is MED only for pre-med students?
faq.a: No. MED welcomes students across pre-health pathways including MD, DO, PA, dental, pharmacy, nursing, PT/OT, and biomedical research.

faq.q: Do I have to attend an info session?
faq.a: Yes. Prospective members should attend at least one official info session to be eligible for the rush cycle. The interview is also required.

faq.q: Do I have to attend every rush event?
faq.a: Info sessions and the interview are required. Additional events help us get to know you—ask Membership Chair which ones are mandatory for this cycle.

faq.q: How much time does membership require?
faq.a: Expect weekly meetings plus programmed service and professional events. Exact hour requirements are published each semester by the chapter.

faq.q: Do you have a GPA requirement?
faq.a: Yes. Chapters typically require a minimum cumulative GPA (often 3.0). Confirm the current threshold with the Membership Chair.
MED is a professional fraternity. Social connection matters, but programming centers on scholarship, service, mentorship, and professional development.

faq.q: When does rush happen at UT?
faq.a: Chi Chapter typically recruits at the start of fall and/or spring. Register for rush to receive this cycle’s dates.
Gift of Life Bone Marrow Registry is MED’s national philanthropy partner. Chapters host donor drives so members can join the registry and advocate for patients with blood cancer.
